commentary_title: Freight rates improve in both the East and the West
commentary_summary: The VLCC tonne-miles index remained stable at around 105.9 points in week 38. Meanwhile, the speed in the West has risen for both ballast and laden vessels, while vessel speeds in the East have slowed down. | Rates firmed up in both the East and the West with vessel loadings towards China seeing an uptick last week. | There were positive gains on both the ex-MEG and ex-USG routes last week. However, there could be a slight softening in rates next week.
